correctness.rationale: The source's Pauli depolarizing map sends one half of a Bell pair to the Bell-diagonal distribution \( (1-p,p/3,p/3,p/3) \). For \(0<p<1/2\), Proposition 10 of arXiv:2211.12804v3 gives \(E_R=1-H_2(p)>0\), and the same paper's Bell-diagonal additivity result yields \(E_R(\rho_p^{\otimes n})=nE_R(\rho_p)\). LOCC monotonicity proves no trace-preserving post-channel LOCC can exceed this value, while identity LOCC attains it. Therefore the supremum equals the undamped input value and cannot be upper-bounded by multiplying that positive value by \(e^{-\kappa n}<1\) for \(\kappa>0\). The accompanying verifier reproduces the numerical instance but the proof is analytic.
